description: Binary assertions for learn-track — journal prompts, competency tracker, behavioral rubric. Static audit of SKILL.md.
test_input: create rubric for Gate Review readiness

assertions.name: description_says_what_first
assertions.check: frontmatter description states what the skill does before its trigger phrases (KN-Stack CLAUDE.md rule 5)

assertions.name: three_modes_routed
assertions.check: routes to Journal, Progress Tracker and Rubric Generator

assertions.name: journal_has_loop_prompt
assertions.check: at least one journal prompt must surface a feedback loop
assertions.regex: At least one prompt must surface a feedback loop

assertions.name: ai_does_not_write_journal
assertions.check: the journal is the learner's to write — the AI generates prompts only
assertions.regex: do not write journal for the learner

assertions.name: tracker_levels_need_evidence
assertions.check: every tracker row carries evidence for the current level

assertions.name: rubric_observable_behavior
assertions.check: rubric indicators are observable behaviors, not vague understanding

assertions.name: rubric_physical_dimension
assertions.check: rubric must include a physical/empirical validation dimension
assertions.regex: At least one dimension must address physical/empirical validation

assertions.name: rubric_failure_dimension
assertions.check: rubric must include an error/failure-handling dimension
assertions.regex: At least one dimension must address error/failure handling
